cases.name: a repair whose vector fails before and passes after is admitted once and shown

argv:
printf '#!/bin/sh
exit 1
' > old && printf '#!/bin/sh
exit 0
' > new && chmod +x old new
'${root}/tests/vectors/bonfyre-vectors' --replay-repair toy.fix --case 'toy refuses nothing / step 1' --before old --after new --before-source fixture --runs 2 v.json > r.json

steps.stderr: bonfyre-capability repair-admit: refused: a different record already holds this id

cases.name: a replay that does not separate the binaries, a missing claim and changed bytes are refused

argv:
printf '#!/bin/sh
exit 1
' > old && printf '#!/bin/sh
exit 0
' > new && chmod +x old new
'${root}/tests/vectors/bonfyre-vectors' --replay-repair toy.bad --case 'toy refuses nothing' --before new --after old v.json > swapped.json

reasons: a before run did not fail the named case
an after run did not pass the whole file

steps.stderr: bonfyre-capability repair-admit: refused: the replay did not replay

argv: '${root}/tests/vectors/bonfyre-vectors' --replay-repair toy.same --case 'toy refuses nothing' --before new --after new v.json

reasons: a before run did not fail the named case
before and after are the same bytes

argv: '${root}/tests/vectors/bonfyre-vectors' --replay-repair toy.other --case 'no such case' --before old --after new v.json

reasons: a before run did not fail the named case

argv: '${root}/tests/vectors/bonfyre-vectors' --replay-repair toy.fix --case 'toy refuses nothing' --before old --after new v.json > r.json

steps.stderr: bonfyre-capability repair-admit: refused: --claim names what was repaired
bonfyre-capability repair-admit: refused: the after binary changed since the replay
bonfyre-capability repair-admit: refused: the vector file changed since the replay
